tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.scope: Repository custom instructions on GitHub.com (cloud agent, code review)

tools.name: Windsurf (Devin Desktop)
tools.scope: Devin Desktop is the new name for Windsurf (June 2026). Cells describe its Devin Local agent, which uses the Devin CLI rules format; the legacy Cascade agent is not covered.
